descriptionEn: Daikon, beef brisket, spiced broth. Hong Kong winter in a clay pot.
descriptionZh: 萝卜、牛腩、香料高汤。砂锅里的香港冬天。

ingrEn: 800g beef brisket, cut into large chunks
1 large daikon, cut into thick rounds
Beef stock or water to cover
stepsEn: Blanch beef brisket 5 min in boiling water. Drain and rinse.
Brown brisket in batches in a clay pot or Dutch oven over high heat. Remove.
Fry ginger briefly in the same pot. Return brisket. Add all sauces, wine, five-spice, star anise, tangerine peel and Sichuan peppercorns.
Add stock or water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer covered 1.5 hours.
Add daikon. Continue simmering covered another 45–60 min until both beef and daikon are completely tender.
Serve in the clay pot. The daikon should have absorbed all the braising liquid color and flavor.
stepsZh: 牛腩冷水焯5分钟，捞出冲洗。
砂锅或铸铁锅大火将牛腩分批煎至上色，取出。
同一口锅短暂爆香姜片，放回牛腩，加入所有酱料、酒、五香粉、八角、陈皮和花椒。
加高汤或清水没过，大火烧开转小火盖锅焖1.5小时。
放入萝卜，继续盖锅焖45-60分钟至牛腩和萝卜均完全软烂。
连砂锅上桌。萝卜应已完全吸收焖汁的色泽与味道。
details.notesEn: The dried tangerine peel is the soul of the Cantonese spice palette — it adds a fragrant bitterness that cuts through the richness. The daikon is arguably better than the beef. It absorbs everything and becomes something else entirely.
details.notesZh: 陈皮是粤式香料的灵魂——它带来一种芬芳的苦涩，穿透浓郁的肉香。萝卜可以说比牛腩更好，它吸收了一切，变成了完全不同的东西。
